base.title: 5-Minute Homemade Cream of Mushroom Sauce
steps: Melt butter in pan, medium heat.
Add milk slowly, stir, simmer 2 minutes.
base.tip: Add milk slowly to avoid lumps.

chicken.title: Cream of Chicken Sauce
chicken.tip: Skip mushrooms for cream of chicken.

celery.title: Cream of Celery Sauce
celery.tip: Chop celery fine for best texture.

double.title: Double Batch Freezer Mushroom Sauce
steps: Cool, freeze in muffin tin, 1/2 cup each.
double.tip: Freeze in muffin tin for easy portions.

chop.title: Smothered Pork Chop and Gravy for One
steps: Pat chop dry, season both sides.
Brown in oil, 3 min per side.
Add sauce and water, stir up bits.
Return chop, cover, low, 8 min, 145°F inside.
chop.tip: Let pork rest 3 minutes before serving.

pure.title: Small Batch Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel, chunk potato, cover with cold water.
Drain, dry in hot pot 1 minute.
pure.tip: Cook potatoes in cold water for even cooking.

tater.title: Tater Tot Hotdish for One
steps: Brown beef and onion, drain fat.
Stir in beans and sauce, spread in dish.
Stand tots in rows on top.
tater.tip: Stand tots up for crispy edges.

arroz.title: Chicken and Rice No-Stir Bake for One
steps: Butter small dish, mix rice, sauce, broth.
arroz.tip: Cover tightly so rice cooks through.

judias.title: Green Bean Casserole for One
steps: Mix beans, sauce, soy, pepper, half onions.
judias.tip: Soy sauce deepens the mushroom flavor.

atun.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole for One
steps: Mix noodles, tuna, peas, sauce, milk.
Spread in dish, top with chips.
atun.tip: Freeze before baking for best texture.

hamb.title: Hamburger Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix beef, crumbs, milk, season, shape patty.
Cook onion 3 min, add sauce and broth.
hamb.tip: Push thumb in patty center to keep it flat.

strog.title: Beef Stroganoff for One
steps: Sear beef strips 1 min per side, remove.
Off heat, stir in sour cream.
strog.tip: Add sour cream off heat to prevent curdling.

potpie.title: Chicken Pot Pie with Biscuit Lid
steps: Warm sauce, broth, thyme, add chicken, veggies.
Pour in dish, press biscuit flat on top.
potpie.tip: Heat filling before baking so biscuit cooks evenly.

brocoli.title: Cheesy Broccoli Rice Bake
steps: Mix rice, broccoli, sauce, milk, most cheese.
Spread in buttered dish, top with cheese, crumbs.
brocoli.tip: Save some cheese for the top.

huevos.title: Creamed Eggs on Toast
steps: Boil eggs, cover, 12 min, cool, peel.
Chop eggs, warm sauce with milk.
Top with paprika and green onion.
huevos.tip: Older eggs peel easier than fresh ones.

papas.title: Scalloped Potatoes and Ham for One
steps: Mix sauce and milk, layer half potatoes, ham, onion, sauce.
Potatoes should be tender and top brown.
papas.tip: Slice potatoes as thin as a nickel.

list.title: My Shopping List for the Week
list.tip: Split the beef into quarter-pound patties and freeze them flat.
